package.name: ugv_base_driver
package.description: Differential-drive UGV base driver: subscribes to /cmd_vel, converts body twist to per-wheel speeds via differential kinematics, and writes the motion command to a serial port. Includes a watchdog that commands zero speed when /cmd_vel stops arriving. Serial protocol is parameterized so the vendor-specific framing can be adapted without touching kinematics or the ROS layer.
